GiveLab is GitLab’s Team Member Volunteer Program. The GiveLab Program lives under the [ESG Team](https://handbook.gitlab.com/job-description-library/legal-and-corporate-affairs/environmental-social-governance/) and is a part of GitLab’s overall [ESG strategy](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/legal/esg/) and program development. The term GiveLab encompasses all Team Member Volunteering initiatives at GitLab.
